findings.title: Replacement lease released before every resident consumer has stopped
findings.root: Two owners of shutdown responsibilities; timed-out joins and exceptional cleanup can outlive the permission lease.
findings.origin: Incomplete closure of preexisting standard-worker ownership; cleanup-finally release is in this PR.
findings.remediation: Drain/cancel all resident workers before final lease release; cleanup errors must not skip other consumers. Keep bounded installer refusal.
findings.limitations: Real threads and OS lease; IO/Kodi boundary doubles and exact Host.close excerpt. No device write or demonstrated physical corruption.

findings.title: Retained source cards keep obsolete seeder/peer counts when zero or cached
findings.root: Optional-field omission assumes fresh ListItem, but this PR retains the object.
findings.remediation: Optional narrow explicit-clear hardening; do not expand into source-pool redesign.
findings.limitations: Renderer accepts conditional changed metadata and retains obsolete fields. Actual SourceListSession.publish keeps first same-key metadata; no normal end-to-end provider reproduction established.

excluded_suspicions.title: Display cap removes a valid focused source on unrelated high-ranked arrival
excluded_suspicions.root: Preliminary renderer-only fixture omitted existing focus reinsertion in real SourceListSession.snapshot.
excluded_suspicions.origin: Inherited cap/ranking boundary left inconsistent with new stable-visibility behavior.
excluded_suspicions.remediation: No product fix required for this suspicion. Preserve current focus reinsertion and keep the integration regression.
excluded_suspicions.limitations: Actual renderer method, Kodi list and metadata helper doubles; no wrong playback proven.
